name: Silk Touch Budding Amethyst
summary: Budding amethyst can be harvested with a Silk Touch tool.

vanilla_changes.change: Vanilla budding amethyst drops nothing. The pack replaces the table with one pool that drops 1 budding_amethyst when the tool has Silk Touch (level 1 or more). Without Silk Touch it still drops nothing.

qol: Lets you move budding amethyst, for example to build an amethyst farm.
getting_started: Mine budding amethyst in an amethyst geode with a Silk Touch pickaxe.
